items.question: How long does it take to go live?
items.answer: Most teams are running within 2 to 6 weeks. If one of our live stations fits your workflow out of the box, like quote matching or inquiry routing, you'll be live in about 2 weeks. If we need to tune the platform to your specific catalogue, SOPs, or systems, plan for 4 to 6 weeks.

items.question: How is our data kept safe?
items.answer: Your formulations, buyer lists, RFPs, and pricing are yours alone. LabGenie processes your data inside your own secure cloud, or through controlled, need-to-access connections; we never store your raw business data on our systems, and the AI runs on Google Vertex AI. We never train shared models on your proprietary data. Access is role-based, every action is logged, and we sign NDAs and data processing agreements before onboarding begins.

items.question: Does it work with the tools we already use?
items.answer: Yes. LabGenie sits on top of what you already run. We integrate with ERPs like SAP (S/4HANA and B1), Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Sage, and Odoo, plus Salesforce, Outlook, Teams, Slack, and the Excel sheets and shared drives your team lives in. If a data source matters to your decisions, we connect to it.

items.question: Can it handle our specific products and formulations?
items.answer: Yes. Each station learns your product catalogue, your SOPs, your spec formats, and your way of describing things. We start by ingesting what your team already references, and the platform gets sharper with every interaction.

items.question: What if we only need one station, not the whole platform?
items.answer: Each station works independently. Most customers start with one, usually the one solving their loudest pain, whether that's quote matching, inquiry routing, or compliance reporting. You expand when you see results. There's no requirement to deploy the full platform on day one.

items.question: How is LabGenie priced?
items.answer: We price on value created, not seats or usage. The starting point is a small percentage of the measurable value LabGenie generates, whether that's hours saved, RFPs won, reduced waste, or faster turnarounds. For new customers we run a three-month proof of concept at a fixed fee so we can measure the actual impact together, then move to value-based pricing once the numbers are real. No long lock-ins, no per-user surprises.
